input:
version: 1
hostname: fr-router
interfaces:
  wan:
    device: eth0
    zone: wan
  lan:
    device: eth1
    zone: lan
    address: 10.73.1.1/24
zones:
  wan: {}
  lan: {}
  vpn: {}
rules:
- name: allow-mgmt-from-lan
  action: accept
  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: self
  proto: tcp
  dst_port: 22
- name: webui-from-lan
  action: accept
  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: self
  proto: tcp
  dst_port: 443
- name: lan-to-wan
  action: accept
  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: wan
nat:
  masquerade:
  - out_zone: wan
dhcp:
  lan:
    range_start: 10.73.1.100
    range_end: 10.73.1.199
    dns_servers:
    - 1.1.1.1
    - 9.9.9.9
management:
  addresses:
  - 192.168.77.1
iot:
  enabled: true
  zones:
  - lan
  auto_isolate: true
  isolation_mode: internet_only
wireguard:
  enabled: true
  address: 10.99.0.1/24
error: 192.168.77.1 is where the webUI and SSH listen (management.addresses), and this change takes it off the router. Move them first: System -> webUI address

version: 1
hostname: fr-router
timezone: Europe/Budapest
zones:
  wan: {}
  lan:
    description: LAN
  iot: {}
  vpn: {}
interfaces:

    device: eth0
    zone: wan

  to_zone: self
  proto: tcp
  dst_port: 22

  action: accept
  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: wan

  action: drop
  from_zone: iot
  to_zone: wan
  schedule:
    days:
    - weekdays

  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: wan

  action: drop
  from_zone: lan
  to_zone: wan
  src_address:
  - 10.73.1.5/32
  - 2001:db8:5::/48
nat:
  masquerade:
  - out_zone: wan
  port_forwards:
  - name: web
    in_zone: wan
    proto: tcp
    dst_port: 0x20FB
    to_address: 10.73.1.10
    to_port: 443
dhcp:
  lan:
    range_start: 10.73.1.100
    range_end: 10.73.1.199
    dns_servers:
    - 10.73.1.1
    reservations:
    - mac: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01
      address: 10.73.1.50
      hostname: nas

  enabled: true

    printer.home.arpa: 10.73.1.60

  interfaces:
  - lan
  blocklist:
  - bad.example

ai_ids:

  excluded_macs:

# Example homelab configuration for the frfw engine.
# Apply with: firewall-cli apply examples/config.yaml [--dry-run]
version: 1
hostname: fr-router

interfaces:
  wan:
    device: eth0
    zone: wan
    description: "ISP uplink"
  lan:
    device: eth1
    zone: lan
    description: "Internal LAN"
  dmz:
    device: eth2
    zone: dmz
    description: "Isolated services"

zones:
  wan:
    description: "Untrusted, internet-facing"
  lan:
    description: "Trusted internal network"
  dmz:
    description: "Publicly reachable services, limited trust"

rules:
  # The router itself is reachable over SSH from the LAN, and from nowhere else.
  - name: allow-ssh-from-lan-to-router
    action: accept
    from_zone: lan
    to_zone: self
    proto: tcp
    dst_port: 22

  # All outbound traffic from the LAN is allowed (towards WAN or DMZ).
  - name: lan-to-wan
    action: accept
    from_zone: lan
    to_zone: wan

  - name: lan-to-dmz
    action: accept
    from_zone: lan
    to_zone: dmz

  # The DMZ only accepts traffic from the WAN on the ports it actually serves
  # (the DNAT itself happens in the nat.port_forwards section; this rule lets
  # the already-DNATed traffic through the forward chain).
  - name: wan-to-dmz-https
    action: accept
    from_zone: wan
    to_zone: dmz
    proto: tcp
    dst_port: 443

  # All other WAN -> LAN/DMZ traffic is explicitly dropped (the policy is
  # drop anyway, but this logs it and documents the intent).
  - name: block-wan-to-lan
    action: drop
    from_zone: wan
    to_zone: lan
    log: true

nat:
  masquerade:
    - out_zone: wan
  port_forwards:
    - name: forward-https-to-dmz-web
      in_zone: wan
      proto: tcp
      dst_port: 443
      to_address: 10.0.2.10
      to_port: 443
